FAQS

Answers to your automation questions.

Most engagements start with a fixed-price scope based on the discovery call, so you know the investment upfront before any build work begins. Larger or ongoing systems can move to a retainer once the initial build is live.

Yes. Every scenario, script, and dashboard is built directly in your accounts, not mine. You get full documentation and a clean handoff — no dependency on me to keep it running.

Every workflow includes error handling and retry logic, plus alerts so failures surface immediately instead of silently dropping data. Edge cases get tested before launch, not discovered after.

Simple workflows (a single trigger-to-action automation) usually ship within a few days. Multi-agent pipelines with several integrations typically take one to three weeks, depending on how many systems need to be wired together.

Yes — a short support window is included after every build, and ongoing maintenance or monitoring can be arranged on a retainer basis if you'd rather not manage it in-house.
